Our spring and field specialists found the advice of Malcolm Coomber (Sprints, horizontal jumps and hurdles) and Mike Winch (discus, shot and javelin) particularly helpful and the results showed in several seasonal personal best performances.
Ernie Obeng left our cold shores early in January to join coach Malcolm Coomber in Florida and to have a crack at the U.S. indoor circuit which, by then, had already got underway.
Coach: Malcolm Coomber 1977 until present. Career: Completed M.Sc. degree in Agriculture at Reading University 1981 at present unemployed.
